import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.xkcd()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6,4))
ax.set_xlim(0,10); ax.set_ylim(0,6); ax.axis('off')
ax.text(5,5.5,'outer skin + PVDF film (vibration)',ha='center')
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((1,4.2),8,0.6,fill=False,lw=2))
ax.text(5,3.5,'silicone pillars (dielectric)',ha='center')
for x in [2,4,6,8]:
  ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((x-0.3,2.8),0.6,0.8,fill=False,lw=2))
ax.text(5,2.2,'PCB with comb electrodes (taxels 2.5mm pitch)',ha='center')
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((1,1.7),8,0.4,fill=False,lw=2))
ax.text(5,1.0,'rigid fingertip core (fixed)',ha='center')
ax.annotate('contact force',xy=(5,4.8),xytext=(8.5,5.2),arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->',lw=2))
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig('sketch.png')
